prompt: Ticket 101: Tauhid Zaman wants one CC-TEE-WHITE tee in size S. Is invoice 501 still unpaid, how overdue is it, and is the vendor blocking new shipments until it's paid?
verification_query: SELECT i.id, i.vendor_id, i.amount, i.due_date, i.status, i.description, v.name AS vendor_name, v.specialty, v.lead_days, (SELECT date_today FROM desk LIMIT 1) AS shop_today, CAST(julianday((SELECT date_today FROM desk LIMIT 1)) - julianday(i.due_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE vendor_id = i.vendor_id AND status != 'paid') AS vendor_open_invoice_count FROM invoices i JOIN vendors v ON v.id = i.vendor_id WHERE i.id = 501;

prompt: Ticket 102: Elm City Properties sent a rent notice for the Chapel Street shop (lease 1). When is the rent due compared with the shop's today, and is there enough cash to cover it?
verification_query: SELECT l.id, l.space_name, l.landlord, l.monthly_rent, l.next_due, l.notes, (SELECT date_today FROM desk LIMIT 1) AS shop_today, CAST(julianday(l.next_due) - julianday((SELECT date_today FROM desk LIMIT 1)) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_due, (SELECT SUM(balance) FROM cash_accounts) AS total_cash, (SELECT SUM(balance) FROM cash_accounts) - l.monthly_rent AS cash_after_rent FROM leases l WHERE l.id = 1;

prompt: Ticket 103: The Yale AI Club wants 20 CC-HOOD-NAVY hoodies in size M at a bulk discount. How many are in stock, how many short are we, and what are the unit cost and list price?
verification_query: SELECT i.sku, i.name, i.size, i.qty, i.location, p.unit_cost, p.list_price, MAX(20 - i.qty, 0) AS shortfall, MAX(20 - i.qty, 0) * p.unit_cost AS restock_cost_at_unit_cost FROM inventory i JOIN pricing p ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.sku = 'CC-HOOD-NAVY' ORDER BY i.size;
